name: StatutoryComplianceMatrix
tagline: Every building, every statutory test, one RAG matrix – with bookings, results, certificates and remedials.
description: A complete statutory compliance app for facilities and property teams: a building × category RAG matrix (fire, lifts, water hygiene, gas, electrical, asbestos, pressure systems, access), a compliance register with quick filters and bulk booking, a 12-month visit and cost forecast, and an overview with compliance % against target. Book visits, record results, add certificates, close remedials with evidence, mark exemptions and produce building compliance statements. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Building × category RAG matrix with reasons and scores
Configurable RAG rules: due soon, book ahead, certificate grace, high-risk remedials
Booking, rescheduling and bulk booking with late-booking reasons
Record results with outcome/remedial validation; certificates; next due rolled forward
Close remedials with evidence; exemption reference for statutory N/A
Search, 11 quick filters, sort, group, CSV export, undo
Phone layout from 320 px, keyboard matrix navigation, ARIA labels
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
